requests.intent: new artwork generation with style/composition references; reference files are not edit targets

request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone decorative environmental illustration layer for Remilo's P01 artwork-only review. Generate a NEW artwork source using the supplied images as direct visual style/composition references; do not modify those reference files and do not reproduce their UI. Match the original references' visual quality closely.
Style/medium: soft 2D editorial/cartoon raster illustration, clean broad rounded asymmetric silhouettes, restrained gentle tonal gradients inside shapes, two to four overlapping layers for depth. Flat illustrated space and smooth edges, very sparse vein accents. No glossy highlights, clay rendering, plastic, photorealism, object-display lighting or dimensional bevels.
Constraints: edge-to-edge environmental composition, crop-safe forms, no enclosing card/frame. All text, labels, dates, logos, phones, app chrome, controls, cards, buttons, category icons and watermarks are ABSENT. No characters, faces, glitter, particles, bokeh, floating decorative orbs, fine noisy texture or isolated centered object. True transparent background/alpha, not a checkerboard painted into the image. A solid atmospheric canvas will be rendered separately by real components later; do not draw that UI. This review generates decorative artwork only.
Input images: Image 1 is the primary botanical style/composition reference: the desired Water plants screen. Use only its integrated foliage/environment. Image 2's green Water plants alarm reinforces broad 2D foliage coverage and soft mint/sage layering. Image 3's Sage editor foliage supports the leaf vocabulary; its isolated alarm sprig is NOT the composition target.
Primary request: Meadow candidate M1, an airy asymmetric botanical canopy. Portrait composition approximately 2:3, useful high-resolution source. Multiple broad leaf clusters enter from the top-left, left side and upper-right, with gently curved branching stems. At least three discernible plant groups. Pale mint/sage background silhouettes and richer muted green foreground leaves overlap naturally. Wide leaves, soft tips, varied size and organic asymmetry; a few quiet veins, never sculpted volume.
Composition: scenery extends across the upper 45-55% of the portrait and softly down both outer edges, with the main central reading region below roughly 45% and the lower action region left clear/transparent. Upper foliage should be substantial and recognizable, like the primary reference, rather than tiny corner stickers. Keep a relaxed quiet opening through the upper middle; no solitary plant rooted at the bottom center. Crop anchor top-center; edge roots may extend beyond the source bounds. The lower central third contains no leaves/stems. Color palette: mint, pale sage, medium soft eucalyptus green and a restrained deep green accent, with no yellow-green glossy lighting.
